description: List the public channels of a Slack workspace, one page at a time. Pass the returned next_cursor back as `cursor` to read the next page; a null next_cursor means the last page.

response_schema.description: conversations.list. Lenient on purpose: Slack returns about thirty fields per channel and keeps adding more.

quirks: Slack answers HTTP 200 with {ok:false, error} for its own failures, so execute.ts turns ok=false into the connector error contract before it maps anything.
types is pinned to public_channel: channels:read grants nothing else. Private channels, group DMs, and DMs need groups:read / mpim:read / im:read, which is a scope change and therefore a v2.
The last page carries an EMPTY next_cursor, not a missing one. Passing the empty string back returns page one forever, so the node reports it as null.
exclude_archived defaults to true here. Slack's own default is false, which buries live channels under years of dead ones.
num_members is omitted on some channel types rather than sent as 0.

cursor.description: The next_cursor returned by the previous page. Omit to start at the first page.

limit.description: How many channels to return in this page.

exclude_archived.description: Leave archived channels out of the page. Defaults to true.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as `cursor` for the next page. Null means this was the last page.
